eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age ≥65 years at the time of vaccination
2. Self-reported ability to understand written and spoken English or Danish (Denmark only) or Spanish or Galician (Spain only)
3. Informed consent form has been signed and dated

Exclusion Criteria:

* There are no specific exclusion criteria for this study

identificationModule.briefTitle: Effectiveness of An Influenza/COVID-19 Vaccine (mCombriax [mRNA-1083]) in Adults ≥ 65 Years
